name: canvas-agent
description: Onboard, sync, and create source-bound Canvas prep and assignment workflows using your chosen coding agent

interface.shortDescription: Local Canvas context and source-bound task workflows
interface.longDescription: Guidance for setting up the Canvas Agent CLI, syncing a local vault, and producing source-bound prep and assignment task candidates in explicit outline, draft, or review modes. Requires a separately installed CLI and local filesystem access. No hosted service, model calls, or coursework submission.
defaultPrompt: Set up Canvas Agent for my courses
Prepare a course week using my local vault
Create an assignment outline from my course prompt
